event: Karmine Corp vs Natus Vincere — Game 1
result: Karmine Corp won Game 1 after NAVI failed to convert a substantial mid-game advantage.
resultSource: user-confirmed result plus user-supplied post-game win-probability graph

modelRecommendation.reasoning: NAVI held two independent current-map confirmations: an early fight/economy advantage and 3-0 Void Grub control. Their draft retained stronger objective-zone damage through Rumble, Jarvan IV and Cassiopeia, with Ezreal providing a third damage channel. KC had not produced a fight, tower or objective counter-confirmation.

execution.selectionAttribution: model-approved exact market and line under immediate price-only tolerance

probationEligibility.note: Official after user confirmation. Selection, price and stake execution complied with the active 1,000,000 VND unit basis and 0.25u per-map cap.

review.resultAssessment: NAVI moneyline lost in full for 250,000 VND (-0.25u).
review.processAssessment: The entry had two valid early confirmations, but they had not yet become durable structure or dragon control. Post-game evidence shows NAVI later built a genuinely strong winning position and still failed to convert, so the loss contains both an entry-calibration issue and a major lead-conversion failure.
review.userAssessment: NAVI threw the game; player difference decided the result.

postGameEvidence.finding: NAVI's estimated win probability reached roughly 70-75% during the late-20-minute phase before collapsing sharply after approximately 30 minutes.
postGameEvidence.finalVisibleCheckpoint: At 40:00 the graph displayed KC at 76% win probability with a 9.2k gold lead.
postGameEvidence.classification: Screenshot-supported throw pattern and failed lead conversion

review.calibrationAction: For underdog live moneylines, require stronger evidence of durable conversion before entry and explicitly discount teams with weak lead-conversion reliability. Kills plus Grubs with a small gold lead are not enough by themselves; prefer tower, dragon, meaningful gold separation, repeated fight wins, or demonstrated map-state control.

notes: User confirmed NAVI Game 1 moneyline at 2.153 for 250,000 VND, slip #1149434459. The wager was model-compliant at 0.25u. The user later confirmed the loss and supplied a win-probability graph showing NAVI held roughly a 70-75% late-midgame position before KC reversed the game.
